caption: The drawing shows an object resembling a small building or kiosk, depicted in a perspective view against a plain, off-white background. The structure has a square base and a pitched, shingled roof with a slight dome-like shape, colored in shades of dark gray and green. The walls of the building are yellowish-brown with darker brown and gray accents suggesting weathering or shadows. The side facing the viewer has two large, arched windows with white grid-like panes. On the front is a recessed entryway with steps leading up to a small doorway, framed by decorative molding in yellow and brown. Above the doorway, the text "HOME SAVINGS" is visible in gold letters on a dark background. Below one of the windows, the word "BANK" is written in large, yellow, capital block letters on a darker band at the base of the building. The structure sits isolated on the page with no additional objects or background elements, and the artist's signature, "W. O. Fletcher," appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Home Savings bank
